name: Paris Romance Tour
description: A seven-day escape through the City of Light for couples seeking romance and culture. Includes a private Seine river cruise, guided tours of the Louvre and Eiffel Tower, wine tasting in Montmartre, and a candlelit dinner at a rooftop restaurant overlooking the city skyline. Boutique hotel accommodation near the Champs-Elysees is included, along with airport transfers and a dedicated local guide throughout the stay.

name: Tokyo Cherry Blossom Trip
description: Experience Japan during the breathtaking cherry blossom season with visits to Ueno Park, Shinjuku Gyoen, and the historic streets of Asakusa. The itinerary includes a bullet train excursion to Kyoto, traditional tea ceremonies, a stay in a hot spring ryokan, and guided food tours through Tokyo's best izakayas and sushi counters, blending modern city life with timeless tradition.

name: New York City Explorer
description: A fast-paced five-day tour of Manhattan covering Times Square, Central Park, the Statue of Liberty, and a Broadway show of your choice. Guests stay in a midtown hotel within walking distance of major attractions, with a guided food tour through Chelsea Market and a helicopter ride over the skyline for unforgettable photo opportunities.

name: Dubai Desert Adventure
description: A thrilling seven-day desert and city combination package featuring dune bashing, camel trekking, and an overnight stay under the stars in a luxury desert camp. City days include the Burj Khalifa observation deck, Dubai Mall, and a dhow cruise dinner along Dubai Creek, balancing adventure with five-star hospitality throughout the trip.

name: Singapore Business and Leisure
description: A flexible seven-day itinerary combining business meetings in the Marina Bay financial district with leisure time exploring Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa Island, and the city's renowned hawker food centres. Airport lounge access and a serviced apartment near the central business district ensure comfort for the working traveller.

name: London Heritage Walk
description: A compact four-day cultural tour of London highlighting the Tower of London, Westminster Abbey, the British Museum, and a West End theatre performance. Includes guided walking tours through historic neighbourhoods, afternoon tea at a classic London hotel, and comfortable accommodation near Covent Garden.

name: Sydney Harbour Escape
description: A thirteen-day exploration of Australia's east coast beginning in Sydney with a harbour bridge climb and Opera House tour, followed by trips to the Blue Mountains, the Great Barrier Reef, and coastal drives along the Pacific Highway. The package includes domestic flights, snorkelling excursions, and stays in beachfront resorts.

name: Bangkok Street Food Safari
description: A five-day culinary adventure through Bangkok's vibrant street food scene, including guided night market tours, a Thai cooking class, temple visits to Wat Arun and the Grand Palace, and a relaxing longtail boat ride along the Chao Phraya River. Budget-friendly accommodation in the Sukhumvit area is included.

name: Rome Ancient Wonders
description: An eight-day journey through Roman history covering the Colosseum, Roman Forum, Vatican Museums, and the Sistine Chapel, complemented by day trips to Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast. Includes skip-the-line guided tours, authentic trattoria dinners, and centrally located accommodation near the historic centre.

name: Bali Beach Getaway
description: A relaxing seven-day retreat combining Bali's beaches and rice terraces, featuring yoga sessions in Ubud, a sunset dinner in Seminyak, snorkelling near Nusa Penida, and traditional Balinese spa treatments. Accommodation is in a private pool villa surrounded by tropical gardens, offering both adventure and tranquillity.

name: Paris Art and Culture Tour
description: A seven-day immersion into Parisian art and culture including private tours of the Musee d'Orsay and Centre Pompidou, a day trip to the Palace of Versailles, and evening jazz performances in Saint-Germain-des-Pres. Stay in a charming boutique hotel in the Latin Quarter with daily breakfast included.

name: Tokyo Neon Nights
description: A nine-day exploration of Tokyo's futuristic side, covering Akihabara, Shibuya Crossing, teamLab digital art museums, and a day trip to Mount Fuji. Evenings include izakaya hopping in Shinjuku and a robot show experience, paired with comfortable stays in a centrally located business hotel.

name: New York Broadway Special
description: A seven-day holiday season trip to New York featuring two Broadway shows, ice skating at Rockefeller Center, shopping along Fifth Avenue, and a viewing of the famous holiday windows. Includes a comfortable midtown hotel stay and a guided tour of the 9/11 Memorial and Museum.

name: Dubai Luxury Skyline Escape
description: A sixteen-day luxury itinerary featuring stays at premium hotels overlooking the Palm Jumeirah, private yacht excursions, fine dining experiences, and a helicopter tour of the coastline. Includes VIP access to the Burj Khalifa, a desert glamping night, and personal concierge service throughout the stay.

name: Rome Romantic Anniversary
description: A five-day anniversary celebration in Rome including a private candlelit dinner near the Trevi Fountain, a guided tour of the Colosseum and Roman Forum, a Vespa sidecar city tour, and a couples' spa evening. Accommodation is in a boutique hotel within walking distance of the historic centre.
